name: search_nodes_library
author: hprebar
title: Search Dynamo nodes library
description: Searches the loaded Dynamo node library across built-in core nodes, Revit nodes, DesignScript functions, and third-party packages matching a query keyword or category filter.
notes: Queries DynamoModel.SearchModel entries with fallback to loaded AppDomain node types.

query.description: Search keyword matching node name, description, or full type signature (e.g. 'Rebar', 'Point', 'Wall', 'List.Map')

category.description: Optional category prefix or namespace to filter results (e.g. 'Revit.Elements', 'Geometry.Points')

maxResults.description: Maximum number of search results to return (clamped between 1 and 200)
